items.sentenceEn: The test was all right, not bad.

items.audioEn: Did you finish your homework? It's due tomorrow.
items.audioZh: 你寫完功課了嗎？明天就要交了。

items.sentenceEn: We're late. Does the class start at nine?
items.sentenceZh: 我們遲到了，課是九點開始嗎？

optionGlossZh: （問句用）do 的第三人稱單數

items.passageEn: Hi, I'm Ben, and this is my sister Amy. She's ten, and I'm twelve. We're from Tainan. Yesterday, we did our homework together. Does Amy like math? No, but she is not bad at it. She likes art. She wants to draw pictures every day.
items.passageZh: 嗨，我是 Ben，這是我的姊妹 Amy。她十歲，我十二歲，我們來自台南。昨天我們一起寫功課。Amy 喜歡數學嗎？不喜歡，不過她數學還不錯。她喜歡美術，想每天都畫畫。

rubricZh: 過去的問句用 did，後面動詞用原形（例如 What did you do?）
yesterday 放句尾或句首都可以

referenceEn: Don't worry. I am all right.
rubricZh: 「沒事」可寫，例如 I'm all right、I am all right、I'm OK 等（alright 也接受）
「別擔心」可寫，例如 Don't worry 等
